title: Neighbourhoods and module stalks at a singleton finite fibre
statement: Let $\pi:Z\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], let $z\in Z$, and put $y=\pi(z)$. Suppose $\pi^{-1}(\{y\})=\{z\}$. For every open neighbourhood $U\subseteq Z$ of $z$ there is an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq Y$ of $y$ such that $\pi^{-1}(V)\subseteq U$. For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal G$ [pqf-def-coherent], the canonical germ map $(\pi_*\mathcal G)_y\to\mathcal G_z$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-modules, where the action on $\mathcal G_z$ is through $\pi_z^\sharp:\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$. Here $(\pi_*\mathcal G)(W)=\mathcal G(\pi^{-1}W)$ for open $W\subseteq Y$ with scalars restricted along the structure sheaf map [def-pc-module-pullback], and stalks are as in [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].
